verdict.rationale: New Relic AI and its MCP server let users ask questions and troubleshoot in plain language, with the MCP server translating natural language into NRQL queries, and docs mention moving toward 'automated remediation' via AI—covering querying and some action-taking via NL. However, evidence for broadly configuring/operating the platform (alerts, dashboards, deployments) purely through natural language, or independent hands-on validation, is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of NL-driven configuration or remediation actions, and evidence natural-language commands cover the full product surface (alerts, dashboards, entity management) rather than just querying.
